spec: Preserve direct terrain crossing exclusively for flying units [P1][P2]
doneWhen: One real Wraith and one real Marine receive identical endpoints; air trajectory directness ratio <= 1.05 and crosses >=1 solid cell; ground trajectory enters 0 solid cells, uses >=1 registered valley cell, and has path distance > air distance; both arrival errors <=16px; labeled screenshot exists at >=1280x720
forbiddenScope: If current behavior passes, modify only harness/screenshot and leave production source unchanged
do not alter unit stats, terrain, pathfinding algorithms, orders, AI, balance, images other than owned screenshot, planning docs except ticket state, config, git, or external systems
